chapter_title_en: The Reforging of the Martial Body
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 267: The Martial Imprint, Sacred Relics, and Keke's Awakening
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen chooses the martial path, enduring body-shattering pain to master the Martial Imprint. Keke awakens, absorbing Paradise Lost. Ancient sages are reborn across the land. Sacred relics from fallen gods are gathered.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch 267: Martial Imprint and Divine Relics
og_description: Xiao Chen endures a agonizing transformation, abandoning his divine ability for a purer martial body. He collects legendary artifacts from fallen demi-gods as Keke awakens and the world hints at the rebirth of ancient sages.
